title: Upstream test disposition mapping
description: Reviewed disposition of every upstream test file in the inventory. Validated by parity/cmd/testinventorycheck: every inventory file has one entry, upstreamTestHash matches the inventory content hash (a changed hash on an upstream leap re-opens the disposition), and each ported/partial/scenario-covered/divergence claim resolves to real evidence.

upstreamTestHash.description: Must equal the inventory file's sha256; binds the disposition to the exact upstream test content.

evidence.description: path or path#fragment references. ported/partial require at least one *_test.go; scenario-covered requires at least one parity/scenarios/**.toml. A #fragment must appear in the referenced file (the upstream test path the proof mirrors).

divergence.description: Required for disposition divergence; must appear in DIVERGENCES.md.
